notablePrerequisites:
Synth Infiltrator on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Synth Infiltrator do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Synth Infiltrator.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Synth Infiltrator.
Activate Synth Infiltrator by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
